Amumu.watch: If Amumu Q Bandage Toss hits, it stuns you; if Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy follows, you stay locked down for a long time. Amumu Q Bandage Toss stops at the first target it hits, so keep a jungle monster between you and Amumu. When his R is available, stay spread out from allies and keep your distance before he closes in.
Amumu.build: Getting caught by Amumu Q Bandage Toss followed by Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is a major risk, so fit Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar between core items. When building defense, account for the maximum health damage from Amumu W Despair: add magic resistance instead of stacking only health.
Amumu.fight: In a fight, dodge Amumu Q Bandage Toss, then close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. Use Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom to absorb damage when Amumu starts unloading his abilities. Keep the fight short to limit damage from Amumu W Despair.
Amumu.laning: Use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge to move between jungle camps and build Bel'Veth P Death in Lavender stacks by participating in large monster takedowns. If a gank is uncertain, clear camps and establish vision around objectives instead of forcing an encounter with Amumu.
Amumu.combo: Dodge Amumu Q Bandage Toss, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, land basic attacks, then knock him up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If W hits, it resets Q's cooldown in that direction, so dash again immediately. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when Amumu unloads his abilities, and do not use other abilities while channeling it.
Amumu.escape: Go in while Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy are down. Amumu has no ability to create distance himself, so landing Bel'Veth W Above and Below after closing in lets you keep up the pressure. Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet can transform you only when coral is available, so do not count on it as an engage tool beforehand.
Amumu.phase: Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, a first core item, and Bel'Veth P Death in Lavender stacks come together to make dueling viable in the mid game. Bel'Veth is strong in the late game with enough stacks, so limit early losses and secure takedowns or assists.
Amumu.teamfight: Stay spread out in open terrain so Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy does not catch grouped allies, and start the fight after Amumu engages. Once your frontline absorbs his engage, use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge to enter the backline from the flank, finish one target, and get back out. If coral drops from a takedown you participate in, transform with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet to prepare for the ensuing fight.

Brand.watch: Brand P Blaze deals damage based on maximum health, and consecutive ability hits stack it until it explodes. Focus on dodging Brand W Pillar of Flame and Brand Q Sear with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. If you are ablaze, Brand Q Sear can stun you, so move out of its projectile path or hide behind a minion.
Brand.build: Prioritize magic resistance against Brand's damage. Since Brand P Blaze deals damage based on maximum health, avoid stacking only health, and consider movement speed to escape telegraphed attack areas.
Brand.fight: Close the gap with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge immediately after Brand W Pillar of Flame is used. Brand has no mobility ability and low armor, making it easier to deal Bel'Veth's physical damage once you reach him. Use Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom to withstand the damage when Brand unloads consecutive abilities.
Brand.laning: Avoid forcing early fights and take large monsters to build Bel'Veth P Death in Lavender stacks. If Brand has set a minion ablaze, do not stand beside it; move to the side of a wave through which Brand E Conflagration could spread. Look for ganks when an ally has guaranteed crowd control or Brand has pushed the lane and has a long way to escape.
Brand.combo: Once Brand W Pillar of Flame is down, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, land basic attacks, and knock him up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If W hits, use the reset Q in that direction to follow him. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when Brand's burst combo lands, and do not use other abilities while channeling it.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility ability, so immediately after Brand W Pillar of Flame is used is your chance to engage. If you are ablaze, dodge the stun from Brand Q Sear before going in. Brand Q Sear does not stun you when you are not ablaze.
Brand.phase: Max Bel'Veth Q Void Surge first and look for duels from mid game, once you have your first core item and stacks. Bel'Veth peaks in late game with enough stacks, so keep securing large monsters and takedown participation.
Brand.teamfight: After your allies absorb the enemy engage, approach Brand from the flank with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. Keep space between yourself and your allies to reduce the spread of Brand E Conflagration and the bounces of Brand R Pyroclasm. Use Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom to withstand concentrated abilities. If a takedown drops Void coral, take it and transform with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet to prepare for the next fight.

Briar.watch: Briar Q Head Rush dashes, stuns, and reduces resistances, so change direction with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge to dodge it. When Briar starts charging Briar E Chilling Scream, interrupt her with Bel'Veth W Above and Below, and avoid fighting with a wall behind you. If Briar R Certain Death hits you and makes you her target, move toward your allies so you can fight back together.
Briar.build: Briar's main damage is physical, so build armor first. If healing from Briar P Crimson Curse, Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, and Briar E Chilling Scream lets her withstand Bel'Veth's sustained damage, buy Executioner's Calling first and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder. Since Briar Q Head Rush reduces resistances, focus on dodging it before stacking more armor.
Briar.fight: Avoid early encounters. Look for duels in mid game after maxing Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and getting your first core item and stacks. Use Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom to withstand Briar's abilities when she unloads them, and do not use other abilities while channeling it. Maintain healing reduction if Briar's healing prolongs the fight.
Briar.laning: Choose gank lanes where an ally has guaranteed crowd control or the target has a long way to escape. If a gank is uncertain, clear camps to build stacks and establish vision around objectives.
Briar.combo: After Briar's mobility ability is used, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, land basic attacks, and knock her up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If W hits, use the reset Q in that direction to go in again. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when Briar starts unloading her burst abilities, and do not use Q or W during it.
Briar.escape: Do not rush in just because Briar Q Head Rush is down; she can still move with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack or Briar R Certain Death. In particular, before Briar R Certain Death comes back up, close the gap with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and land Bel'Veth W Above and Below while her other mobility and crowd control are down. Consider Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet as an engage tool only when coral is available to use it.
Briar.phase: Bel'Veth is weak early, while Briar has high early kill participation, so avoid encounters. In mid game, maxed Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, a first core item, and stacks make duels viable. In late game, more Bel'Veth P Death in Lavender stacks favor Bel'Veth, so secure large monsters and takedown participation in teamfights.
Briar.teamfight: Have your frontline stand in the path of Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack to protect your backline damage dealers and absorb the initial hit from Briar R Certain Death for them. After your allies absorb her engage, enter from the flank with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, finish one target, and retreat with Q again. Use Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom to withstand focused attacks, and take any coral that drops after a takedown to prepare for the next fight.

Ekko.watch: When the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence appears, leave the marked area to avoid the stun and shield. Stay out of the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder, and if the afterimage of Ekko R Chronobreak is visible, do not overcommit to a chase even at low health.
Ekko.build: If the healing from Ekko R Chronobreak makes it hard to finish him with Bel'Veth's sustained damage, buy Executioner's Calling first and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder. Build magic resistance against Ekko's magic damage, but prioritize tenacity if Bel'Veth Q Void Surge is unavailable and dodging the stun from Ekko W Parallel Convergence is difficult.
Ekko.fight: Avoid the area of Ekko W Parallel Convergence and take short fights to create chances to force out Ekko R Chronobreak. When both Ekko E Phase Dive and R are available, do not chase too far just because one has been used; commit to the fight after R is down.
Ekko.laning: Attempt ganks in lanes where an ally has guaranteed crowd control or Ekko has a long way to escape. Lead with Bel'Veth W Above and Below so he has no opening to escape with Ekko E Phase Dive.
Ekko.combo: Look for a chance to knock Ekko up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below right after he closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive. If you close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, land basic attacks, and hit W, follow him again with the reset Q in that direction. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when Ekko unloads his abilities, and do not use Q or W while channeling it.
Ekko.escape: Look for an opening when Ekko W Parallel Convergence and R Chronobreak are both down. If Ekko E Phase Dive has also just become unavailable, close the gap with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and cut off his escape direction with Bel'Veth W Above and Below.
Ekko.phase: Look for duels from mid game, once Bel'Veth Q Void Surge is maxed, your first core item is complete, and stacks are building. Bel'Veth has the advantage in late game with enough stacks.
Ekko.teamfight: After your allies absorb Ekko's engage, enter from the flank with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. Knock him up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below right after he closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, and use Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom to withstand concentrated abilities. If coral drops after a kill, take it and use Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet to prepare for the next fight.

Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves through the air and marks you, so sidestep it with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. If you are marked, create distance immediately because Diana E Lunar Rush may reset. Avoid fighting just after Diana activates W Pale Cascade or when she has an angle to engage with Diana R Moonfall.
Diana.build: Prioritize magic resistance starting with your first purchase. Diana P Moonsilver Blade, Diana Q Crescent Strike, and Diana W Pale Cascade all deal magic damage, and movement speed to get out of their telegraphed areas is also useful.
Diana.fight: Trade after Diana W Pale Cascade's orbs and shield are gone. If you dodge Diana Q Crescent Strike and she has used Diana E Lunar Rush, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and knock her up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when she unloads her abilities.
Diana.laning: Gank lanes where an ally has guaranteed crowd control or the enemy has a long way to retreat.
Diana.combo: Once Diana E Lunar Rush is down, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, basic attack, and knock her up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If W hits, dash in again with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge in the reset direction. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom as Diana's burst combo comes in, and do not press other abilities while channeling it.
Diana.escape: If Diana Q Crescent Strike marks you, Diana E Lunar Rush may let her dash in again. Use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge to retreat while changing direction. If Diana engages with E Lunar Rush without a Q mark, the moment after she uses it is your chance to catch her with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. Use Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet to engage only when you can secure coral and transform.
Diana.phase: In the mid game, look for duels once you have stacks and your first core item. Bel'Veth gains the advantage in the late game when she has enough stacks.
Diana.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Diana R Moonfall does not pull in several of you, and use vision to watch for her flank engage angles. After your allies absorb her engage, enter from the side with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and withstand concentrated abilities with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom as they come in. If coral drops from a takedown you participate in, collect it, transform with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet, and prepare for the next fight.

Elise.watch: At full health, watch for the human-form attack from Elise Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite. After health has dropped, watch for the finishing attack when she switches to Elise R Spider Form.
Elise.build: Build magic resistance first against Elise's main ability damage, and consider armor to withstand her basic attacks. If healing from Elise P Spider Queen makes her hard to finish with sustained damage, buy Executioner's Calling first and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Elise.fight: Avoid early encounters. Once Elise E Cocoon and Elise E Rappel are down, close the distance with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when Elise engages in R Spider Form and unloads her damage, and do not press other abilities while using it.
Elise.combo: Once Elise has used a movement ability or Elise E Rappel, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, basic attack, and knock her up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If Bel'Veth W Above and Below hits, dash in again with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge in the reset direction. Withstand Elise's burst with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom as it begins.
Elise.escape: The moment after Elise uses Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite is a chance to close the distance. If Elise E Cocoon and Elise E Rappel are also down, engage with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and land Bel'Veth W Above and Below.
Elise.phase: In the mid game, you can look for duels once Bel'Veth has maxed Q Void Surge and has her first core item and stacks. In the late game, more stacks of Bel'Veth P Death in Lavender increasingly favor her.
Elise.teamfight: After your allies absorb Elise's engage, enter from the side with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and target one enemy. Withstand Elise's focused attacks with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom. If a kill drops Void Coral, transform with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet and continue into the next fight.
Elise.laning: Early on, secure plenty of vision and avoid pushing the lane too hard when Elise is out of sight. When ganking, choose lanes where an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has a long escape route. If the opportunity is unclear, take a large monster to build Bel'Veth P Death in Lavender stacks.

Evelynn.watch: When the mark from Evelynn W Allure appears, alert your allies and retreat toward vision before the charm completes. At low health, Evelynn R Last Caress can finish you, so do not remain somewhere without vision.
Evelynn.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Evelynn Q Hate Spike, Evelynn W Allure, and Evelynn E Whiplash. Evelynn W Allure reduces magic resistance, though, so retreating before the mark completes takes priority. If healing from Evelynn P Demon Shade makes her hard to finish with sustained damage, buy Executioner's Calling first and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Evelynn.fight: Avoid early encounters. Look for duels after Bel'Veth has Q Void Surge, her first core item, and stacks. Evelynn can escape with E Whiplash and R Last Caress, so check which movement options she has before cutting off her retreat with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when Evelynn starts unloading her damage.
Evelynn.laning: Early on, do not force encounters by entering Evelynn's jungle. Take large monsters to build stacks of Bel'Veth P Death in Lavender. Maintain vision with Control Wards and regular wards at spots where Evelynn starts fights beside camps. Gank lanes where an ally has crowd control or the enemy has a long way to retreat.
Evelynn.combo: Close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and basic attack, but save Bel'Veth W Above and Below if Evelynn still has a movement option. Land Bel'Veth W Above and Below to cut off her retreat, then follow with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge in the reset direction. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when Evelynn attacks, and do not press Bel'Veth Q Void Surge or Bel'Veth W Above and Below while maintaining it.
Evelynn.escape: If Evelynn has used only E Whiplash, do not rush the chase; she can still escape with Evelynn R Last Caress. After she uses Evelynn R Last Caress, especially before she can use it again, you have an opening to engage. Close the distance with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and cut off her escape route with Bel'Veth W Above and Below.
Evelynn.phase: Bel'Veth can duel from the mid game once she has Q Void Surge, her first core item, and growing stacks. She is strongest in the late game when she has enough stacks.
Evelynn.teamfight: While your allies absorb Evelynn's engage, keep your backline damage dealers within vision. Catch Evelynn with Bel'Veth W Above and Below when she enters. Then enter from the side with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge to kill one enemy, and withstand focused attacks with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom. If a takedown drops Void Coral, collect it, transform with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet, and prepare for the next fight.

Fiddlesticks.build: If healing from Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest makes him hard to finish with sustained damage, buy Executioner's Calling first and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Fiddlesticks' damage.
Fiddlesticks.fight: When Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest begins, interrupt it with Bel'Veth W Above and Below to reduce his healing and chance to use it again. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when Fiddlesticks unloads his damage, and do not press other abilities during its cast.
Fiddlesticks.combo: After Fiddlesticks uses his means of escape, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, basic attack, and knock him up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If it hits, use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge again in the reset direction to follow him. Withstand his burst with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when it begins.
Fiddlesticks.escape: After Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and the silence from Fiddlesticks E Reap are down, it is a good time to approach with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. If you cannot interrupt Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm, leave its area.
Fiddlesticks.phase: Look for duels from the mid game, once you have maxed Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, completed your first core item, and built stacks. In the late game, fight using stacks of Bel'Veth P Death in Lavender, but keep watching for Fiddlesticks to ambush you from outside vision.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Spread out so Fiddlesticks' area abilities do not hit several of you, and do not bunch up when entering narrow passages without vision. After your allies absorb his engage, enter from the side with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and target one enemy. Withstand focused damage with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom. If a takedown drops coral, transform with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet and prepare for the next fight.
Fiddlesticks.laning: Early on, avoid jungle skirmishes with Fiddlesticks and take large monsters to build Bel'Veth P Death in Lavender stacks. Look to gank when an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has pushed the lane and has a long escape route. Keep the brush behind the lane warded, and don't pass by an unchecked Fiddlesticks P A Harmless Scarecrow.
Fiddlesticks.watch: Since Fiddlesticks's abilities can fear you if they hit from an area without vision, check bushes and narrow entrances before approaching. If you see Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm channeling, interrupt it with Bel'Veth W Above and Below; if you can't, use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge to get out of range.

Gragas.watch: When you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll, move out of its radius immediately. If Gragas E Body Slam hits you near the barrel, you are likely to take both abilities, so change direction with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge to dodge. When Gragas has R Explosive Cask, do not stand with your back to the enemy turret or team.
Gragas.build: Build magic resistance rather than armor to withstand Gragas's damage. If Gragas's high armor blunts Bel'Veth's physical damage, add armor penetration. If his healing makes him hard to finish with sustained damage, buy Executioner's Calling first and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Gragas.fight: Right after Gragas uses E Body Slam, close the gap with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and cut off his escape with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. Save your burst while he drinks with Gragas W Drunken Rage, then attack when its damage reduction ends. When Gragas starts unloading his abilities, withstand the damage with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom.
Gragas.laning: Early on, avoid forcing fights with Gragas. Clear large monsters to build Bel'Veth's stacks. Gank lanes where an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has a long way to retreat. If Gragas Q Barrel Roll is placed near you, use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge to leave its radius.
Gragas.combo: When Gragas E Body Slam is down, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, basic attack, and knock him up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If Bel'Veth W Above and Below hits, use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge again in the reset direction to follow him. When Gragas starts his burst combo, activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom and do not press other abilities while channeling it.
Gragas.escape: Your opening to engage comes right after you make Gragas use E Body Slam. Close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and knock him up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below to leave him less time to escape. Gragas E Body Slam has a much shorter cooldown when it hits, so do not chase deep unless you can secure the kill.
Gragas.phase: Gragas has strong burst and can disrupt your formation in the early and mid game, so hold your formation and withstand him during objective fights at that stage. Once Bel'Veth has enough stacks in the late game, she has the advantage in sustained damage.
Gragas.teamfight: After your tank absorbs Gragas's engage, enter from the side with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and focus one target. If abilities are focused on you, withstand them with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom. After a kill, collect the dropped coral and prepare for the next fight with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet. If Gragas E Body Slam hits you, leave the barrel's radius before fighting back.

Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line detonates immediately when it hits terrain, so avoid fighting with your back to a wall. If you are caught in Graves W Smoke Screen, your vision is blocked and you are slowed; use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge to take the shortest route out, then close in again. Basic attacks from Graves P New Destiny are blocked by the first unit they hit, so fight with a minion or ally between you and Graves.
Graves.build: The main damage from Graves P New Destiny, Q End of the Line, and R Collateral Damage is physical, so build armor first. Buy Plated Steelcaps earlier for early and mid game fights.
Graves.fight: Fight back or create distance while Graves reloads after firing two shots. Close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge in open terrain, then reduce the damage with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom the moment Graves unloads his abilities. Pressing another ability during Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom interrupts its channel, so hold it for as long as needed before moving.
Graves.laning: Gank lanes where an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has pushed up and has a long way to retreat. If a gank is uncertain, clear large monsters and establish vision around objectives.
Graves.combo: Close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and basic attack, then cut off Graves's escape path from E Quickdraw or R Collateral Damage with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If Bel'Veth W Above and Below hits, it resets the cooldown of Bel'Veth Q Void Surge in that direction, so immediately engage again. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when Graves's burst damage comes in.
Graves.escape: If only Graves E Quickdraw is down, he can still create distance with R Collateral Damage, so do not rush your engage. Before Graves R Collateral Damage comes back up, draw out his movement options, then close the gap with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and land Bel'Veth W Above and Below.
Graves.phase: Look for duels from the mid game, once you have maxed Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, completed your first core item, and begun building stacks. The more stacks Bel'Veth has in the late game, the stronger she is, but Graves also grows stronger through E Quickdraw stacks. Keep clearing large monsters and contributing to kills in team fights.
Graves.teamfight: After your tank absorbs the engage, enter the backline from the side with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, finish one target, and retreat. Keep an ally or minion between you and Graves to block his basic attacks, and withstand focused damage with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom. If Void Coral drops after a kill, transform with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet and join the next fight.

Hecarim.watch: The farther Hecarim travels with E Devastating Charge, the more damage and knockback it deals. When he turns and starts charging, break vision or move toward your allies. Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows can fear multiple people, so do not stand grouped with your team.
Hecarim.build: If healing from Hecarim W Spirit of Dread makes him hard to finish with sustained damage, buy Executioner's Calling first and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder. Bel'Veth can keep applying healing reduction with basic attacks and Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. Build armor first against the physical damage from Hecarim Q Rampage and Hecarim E Devastating Charge.
Hecarim.fight: Avoid early skirmishes. Once you have grown stronger, look to fight before Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows comes back up. Slowing Hecarim reduces both his ability to reach you and his damage, so look for a chance to land Bel'Veth W Above and Below.
Hecarim.laning: Gank lanes where an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has a long way to retreat.
Hecarim.combo: After checking Hecarim's escape options, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, basic attack, and knock him up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If Bel'Veth W Above and Below hits, it resets the cooldown of Bel'Veth Q Void Surge in that direction, so immediately use it to engage again. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom the moment Hecarim unloads his abilities, and do not press Bel'Veth Q Void Surge or Bel'Veth W Above and Below while channeling it.
Hecarim.escape: If only Hecarim E Devastating Charge is down, he can still escape with R Onslaught of Shadows, so do not force an engage. Especially before Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows comes back up, check his remaining movement options, then close the gap with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and cut off his escape path with Bel'Veth W Above and Below.
Hecarim.phase: Duels become viable from the mid game, once you have maxed Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, completed your first core item, and begun building stacks. Bel'Veth is at her strongest in the late game with enough stacks, so keep clearing large monsters and contributing to kills in fights.
Hecarim.teamfight: Keep your distance from allies so Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows cannot catch several of you. After an ally absorbs Hecarim's engage, enter from the side with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. Having several allies fight for a long time inside Hecarim W Spirit of Dread helps him heal, so finish one target quickly or retreat and reengage. If coral drops after a kill, collect it, transform with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet, and prepare for the next fight.

Ivern.watch: If Ivern Q Rootcaller roots you, Ivern's allies can dash into range of you. Before he fires it, keep a minion or terrain between you and him to avoid a clear shot. The target of Ivern E Triggerseed remains slowed after it explodes, so do not engage immediately. If Ivern R Daisy! starts attacking you, reposition to avoid the knockup from three consecutive attacks.
Ivern.build: Once Bel'Veth completes her first core item and builds attack speed, the cooldown of Bel'Veth Q Void Surge also gets shorter. Magic resistance is better than armor against Ivern's damage, but prioritize tenacity if your allies will join while Ivern Q Rootcaller and Ivern R Daisy! keep you locked down.
Ivern.fight: Make Ivern use Q Rootcaller, then close the gap with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. If a target already has Ivern E Triggerseed, wait until the shield explodes before going after them. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom as the enemy uses their abilities, and do not press other abilities while channeling it. If only Ivern is left, do not chase deep after him through dashes and brush.
Ivern.laning: Use vision to track Ivern's route when he comes to harvest camps where he has planted seeds, and watch for ambushes when passing newly created brush. Gank lanes where an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has a long way to retreat.
Ivern.combo: After Ivern Q Rootcaller is down, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, basic attack, and knock him up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If Bel'Veth W Above and Below hits a champion, use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge again in the reset direction to follow them. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when the enemy's burst damage comes in, and do not press Bel'Veth Q Void Surge or Bel'Veth W Above and Below while channeling it.
Ivern.escape: The moment Ivern Q Rootcaller is down is your opening to engage. Approach with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and cut off his escape direction with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If Ivern R Daisy! is landing consecutive attacks on you or you need to retreat, use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge in changing directions to get away.
Ivern.phase: Duels become viable from the mid game, once you have maxed Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, completed your first core item, and built stacks. Bel'Veth has the advantage in the late game with enough stacks, so keep growing stronger by contributing to kills.
Ivern.teamfight: When targeted abilities are focused on you, withstand them with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom. If coral drops after a kill, transform with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet and prepare for the next fight. Check your angle before using Bel'Veth W Above and Below on an enemy behind Ivern R Daisy!, as Daisy may take the hit instead.

JarvanIV.fight: Avoid early skirmishes. Prioritize leveling Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, then look for duels once you have your first core item and stacks.
JarvanIV.laning: If an early gank opportunity is uncertain, do not force it. Farm the jungle and secure vision around objectives.
JarvanIV.combo: If Bel'Veth W Above and Below hits, immediately go back in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge in the reset direction.
JarvanIV.escape: In particular, the period after R has been used and before it becomes available again is an opportunity. At that point, close the gap with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and cut off the escape route with Bel'Veth W Above and Below.
JarvanIV.teamfight: If a takedown drops coral, collect it and transform with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet to look for the next fight.

Jax.watch: Jax E Counter Strike negates basic attacks and stuns an area when reactivated. Do not basic attack while it is active; use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge to leave the stun range. Jax can close in with Jax Q Leap Strike, so look to land Bel'Veth W Above and Below after he uses the leap.
Jax.build: The source does not specify Bel'Veth's first purchase, so it cannot be identified. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so avoid building only one type of resistance. Jax E Counter Strike also deals damage based on maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone.
Jax.fight: Go in after Jax E Counter Strike ends and Jax Q Leap Strike is down. Close the gap with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, knock him up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below, then keep basic attacking. Use Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom to withstand the damage the moment Jax unloads his attacks.
Jax.laning: For ganks, choose a lane where an ally has guaranteed crowd control or Jax has a long way to escape. Draw out Jax Q Leap Strike, then cut off his escape with Bel'Veth W Above and Below.
Jax.combo: Once Jax E Counter Strike ends and Jax Q Leap Strike is down, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, basic attack, and knock him up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If W hits, it resets Q's cooldown in that direction, so engage again with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when Jax's attacks are concentrated on you, and do not press Q or W during its cast.
Jax.escape: While Jax E Counter Strike is active, save Bel'Veth Q Void Surge to escape the stun range. If you enter during the window after Jax E Counter Strike ends and Jax Q Leap Strike is also down, you can land Bel'Veth W Above and Below and chase with the reset Q.
Jax.phase: Bel'Veth has the advantage in the late game with accumulated stacks, so keep securing large monsters and participating in takedowns in fights.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax jumps in with Jax E Counter Strike active, do not group up nearby. Wait for the area stun to end. After your allies absorb his engage, enter from the side with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and knock him up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below as soon as Jax E Counter Strike ends. If a takedown drops coral, transform with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet to prepare for the next fight.

Karthus.watch: Karthus Q Lay Waste deals more damage if it hits you alone. When its detonation indicator appears, change direction with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge to dodge it. Karthus W Wall of Pain reduces magic resistance and slows, so go around the wall, and do not stay in Karthus E Defile for long. Even after killing Karthus, leave his body immediately to avoid abilities cast through Karthus P Death Defied.
Karthus.build: All of Karthus's damage is magic damage, so build magic resistance over armor. Get movement speed first to make it easier to avoid the marked area of Karthus Q Lay Waste and Karthus W Wall of Pain.
Karthus.fight: Karthus has no ability to create distance on his own. Close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, then deal damage with basic attacks. Change your Q direction to move away from where Karthus Q Lay Waste will land, and use Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when he unleashes his abilities. After the kill, leave his body instead of staying there.
Karthus.laning: If health has decreased, recall after considering whether Karthus R Requiem can be survived.
Karthus.combo: Close in on Karthus with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, basic attack, and knock him up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If W hits, it resets Q's cooldown in that direction, so immediately go back in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when Karthus's ability damage comes in, and do not press Q or W during its cast.
Karthus.escape: Karthus has no mobility or immobilizing ability, so go in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge when you can approach without crossing Karthus W Wall of Pain. If the wall blocks your path, go around it. If you need to leave after using Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom to withstand damage, end E and escape with Q.
Karthus.phase: In the mid game, Bel'Veth can duel once she has maxed Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, completed her first core item, and built stacks. She is strong in the late game with enough stacks, so keep securing large monsters and participating in takedowns in fights.
Karthus.teamfight: After your allies absorb the enemy engage, enter from the side with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and target Karthus. Do not stay in Karthus E Defile for long. If you kill him, immediately move away from his body to avoid damage through Karthus P Death Defied. If you collect the dropped coral, transform with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet to prepare for the next fight.

Kayn.watch: Dodge the linear hitbox of Kayn W Blade's Reach with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. If Blade's Reach hits you and deals damage, Kayn can follow up with R Umbral Trespass. Kayn Q Reaping Slash deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful when you're close to him.
Kayn.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Kayn Q Reaping Slash, Kayn W Blade's Reach, and Kayn R Umbral Trespass. Stacking health alone also increases the damage from Kayn Q Reaping Slash. If Kayn has transformed into the Darkin and his healing makes extended fights difficult, buy Executioner's Calling, then upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Kayn.fight: Dodge Kayn W Blade's Reach with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, then engage before Kayn R Umbral Trespass is available again. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when Kayn unleashes his abilities, and do not press other abilities while it is active.
Kayn.laning: Early on, prioritize large monsters over forced ganks to build stacks of Bel'Veth P Death in Lavender, and establish vision around objectives. If a warning indicator for Kayn E Shadow Step appears at the edge of a wall, stop fighting there and retreat toward your turret.
Kayn.combo: After dodging Kayn W Blade's Reach and once his movement ability is down, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and basic attack. Knock him up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below, then go back in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge in the direction reset by the hit. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when Kayn starts using his abilities to fight back.
Kayn.escape: Do not rush in just because Kayn Q Reaping Slash is down; he can escape with Kayn R Umbral Trespass. Before his R is available again, dodge Kayn W Blade's Reach, then close the gap with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and land Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If you have Void Coral and can transform, you can also use the dash from Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet to close the gap.
Kayn.phase: Kayn is also weak before transforming. Pressure his jungle pathing and objectives during that period without giving up kills. Bel'Veth can duel from the mid game once she has maxed Q, completed her first core item, and built stacks; she is strongest later with enough stacks.
Kayn.teamfight: After your allies absorb Kayn's engage, enter from the side with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and target one enemy in the backline. If Kayn R Umbral Trespass enters an ally, prepare Bel'Veth W Above and Below near that ally to interrupt Kayn as he emerges. If a kill drops coral, transform with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet to prepare for the next fight.

Khazix.watch: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear deals much more damage when you're isolated, so fight near allies or minions. If Kha'Zix disappears with R Void Assault, stay close to your allies and counterattack when he reappears instead of trying to find him.
Khazix.build: Kha'Zix deals mostly physical damage, so build armor first. If healing from Kha'Zix W Void Spike makes him hard to kill with Bel'Veth's sustained damage, buy Executioner's Calling first and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Khazix.fight: Counterattack right after Kha'Zix uses Kha'Zix E Leap to engage. Use Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom to reduce the damage when he unloads his abilities, then adjust your distance with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge once you have weathered the burst.
Khazix.laning: Gank lanes where an ally has reliable crowd control or the target has a long way to retreat. Maintain vision in river bushes and bushes at jungle entrances.
Khazix.combo: After Kha'Zix uses Kha'Zix E Leap, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, land basic attacks, and knock him up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If W hits, it resets Q's cooldown in that direction, so immediately use Q to reengage.
Khazix.escape: Right after Kha'Zix uses Kha'Zix E Leap, engage with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and save Bel'Veth W Above and Below to stop his escape. If he tries to burst you first, withstand it with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom. When you need to disengage, retreat by using Q in different directions.
Khazix.phase: Duels become viable in mid game once Q is maxed, your first core item is complete, and you are building stacks. If Kha'Zix has two or more evolutions, stop moving alone. With enough stacks, Bel'Veth has the advantage in late game, so join team fights and secure takedown participation.
Khazix.teamfight: Group with allies in a narrow area where you have vision to avoid the isolation damage from Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear. After your tank absorbs the engage, enter from the side with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and focus one target. If you are focused, withstand the damage with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom. If a coral drops after a kill, use Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet to transform and prepare for the next fight.

Kindred.watch: If you keep taking hits after Kindred E Mounting Dread is applied, you will take heavy damage based on your missing health, so create distance or break line of sight. Inside Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy, Kindred can use Kindred Q Dance of Arrows frequently to get away, so do not chase her there for long.
Kindred.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and Kindred E Mounting Dread. If healing from Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy and Kindred R Lamb's Respite prolongs duels, buy Executioner's Calling and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Kindred.fight: Do not force an engage while Kindred still has mobility available. Look for a window before Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy comes back. Close the gap with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, then knock her up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If Kindred E Mounting Dread has hit you and you have lost health, create distance.
Kindred.laning: Kill camps marked by Kindred P Mark of the Kindred first, or establish vision nearby to slow Kindred's growth. Gank lanes where an ally has reliable crowd control or the target has a long way to retreat.
Kindred.combo: Close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, land basic attacks, then knock Kindred up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If W hits, it resets the cooldown of Bel'Veth Q Void Surge in that direction, so immediately engage again. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when Kindred unloads her damage, and do not press other abilities while channeling it.
Kindred.escape: Do not rush an engage just because Kindred Q Dance of Arrows is down; she can still escape with Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy. In particular, before W comes back, use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge to close in and land Bel'Veth W Above and Below when Kindred's mobility is unavailable.
Kindred.phase: Look for duels from mid game onward, once Bel'Veth Q Void Surge is maxed, your first core item is complete, and you are building stacks. Bel'Veth is at her strongest in late game with enough stacks, so slow Kindred's acquisition of Kindred P Mark of the Kindred until then.
Kindred.teamfight: After an ally absorbs Kindred's engage, enter from the side with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, focus one target, and back out. When Kindred R Lamb's Respite activates, enter its area so low-health allies can survive too. If takedown participation drops a Void Coral, collect it, transform with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet, and prepare for the next fight.

LeeSin.watch: Lee Sin can enter from over a wall with Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will, so keep your distance from walls you cannot see over.
LeeSin.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. Armor does not reduce the magic damage from Lee Sin E Tempest / Cripple. Consider Grievous Wounds if the lifesteal from Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will helps him last through long fights.
LeeSin.fight: Avoid early skirmishes and fight before Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike comes back. Close the gap with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, but save Bel'Veth W Above and Below in case Lee Sin escapes with Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will. When Lee Sin starts unloading his abilities, activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom and do not press other abilities while channeling it.
LeeSin.laning: Gank lanes where an ally has reliable crowd control or the target has a long way to retreat. In areas where you expect a gank, keep minions or jungle monsters between you and Lee Sin to avoid a straight-line shot from Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike.
LeeSin.combo: While Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike is down, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and use basic attacks. Check what mobility Lee Sin still has before knocking him up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If it hits, reengage with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge in the direction it reset. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when Lee Sin's burst begins.
LeeSin.escape: The window before Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike comes back is your chance to engage. If Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will is also available, he can escape with it, so check his mobility before using Bel'Veth W Above and Below to cut off his escape route. When you need to retreat, use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge in different directions to get away.
LeeSin.phase: In mid game, duels become viable as you level Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, complete your first core item, and build stacks. In late game, more stacks increasingly favor Bel'Veth, so limit early losses and secure large monsters and takedown participation.
LeeSin.teamfight: After your frontline absorbs Lee Sin's engage, use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge to enter from the flank and target one enemy. Keep some distance from your allies so you aren't caught alongside the target hit by Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. If damage focuses on you, hold on with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom. If coral drops after a kill, check for it, transform with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet, and prepare for the next fight.

Lillia.watch: Dodge Lillia Q Blooming Blows and Lillia E Swirlseed to avoid meeting the sleep condition for Lillia R Lilting Lullaby. If you become drowsy, you can still move before falling asleep, so use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge to reach safety. When you see the animation for Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!, move sideways to avoid its center.
Lillia.build: If healing from Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough makes her hard to bring down with sustained attacks, buy Executioner's Calling first and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder. Build magic resistance first against her damage, but account for the true damage from Lillia Q Blooming Blows, which resistance cannot reduce, and the maximum-health scaling of Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough.
Lillia.fight: Lillia is hard to chase while she has movement speed stacks from landing abilities. Dodge her attacks and wait until she has no stacks. Right after she uses Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and knock her up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. When Lillia unloads her attacks, withstand the damage with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom.
Lillia.laning: When you do not know Lillia's location, avoid walking straight through narrow jungle entrances or river passages where Lillia E Swirlseed is hard to dodge. Gank lanes where an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has pushed up and has a long way to retreat.
Lillia.combo: When Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is down, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, land basic attacks, and knock her up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If W hits, use the reset Bel'Veth Q Void Surge in the direction you cast W to follow her. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when Lillia's heavy attack comes in, and do not press other abilities while channeling it.
Lillia.escape: Right after Lillia uses Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is your chance to engage. Dodge Lillia Q Blooming Blows and Lillia E Swirlseed, then close the gap with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and cut off her escape with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If you have secured a coral and can use Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet, its dash can also close the gap.
Lillia.phase: Look for duels from mid game onward, after strengthening Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, completing your first core item, and building stacks of Bel'Veth P Death in Lavender. Bel'Veth has the advantage in late game with enough stacks, so keep growing by killing large monsters and joining fights.
Lillia.teamfight: After your allies absorb the enemy engage, enter from the side with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. Save Bel'Veth W Above and Below to catch Lillia if she enters from the flank, and withstand focused attacks with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom. If a coral drops after a kill, collect it, transform with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet, and prepare for the next fight.

Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss hurts more when it hits from farther away, so dodge its path and watch jungle entrances and the river for Nidalee W Bushwhack traps. If a spear or trap marks you as Hunted, be ready for Nidalee W Pounce followed by Nidalee Q Takedown.
Nidalee.build: If Nidalee E Primal Surge makes her hard to finish with Bel'Veth's sustained damage, buy Executioner's Calling first and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Nidalee's damage, but prioritize dodging Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range.
Nidalee.fight: Avoid early skirmishes and fight once you have stacks and items. After drawing out Nidalee W Pounce, close the gap with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and knock her up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. Use Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when Nidalee dives in and starts dealing damage.
Nidalee.laning: Early on, take large monsters to build Bel'Veth P Death in Lavender stacks. For ganks, favor allied lanes with reliable crowd control or enemy lanes where the target has a long escape route over forcing a gank. Check and clear Nidalee W Bushwhack traps at jungle entrances and in the river with a Control Ward or an area ability before entering.
Nidalee.combo: Once Nidalee W Pounce is down, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, basic attack, and knock her up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If W hits, it resets Q's cooldown in that direction, so use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge to close in again. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom as Nidalee deals her burst damage, and do not use other abilities during its channel.
Nidalee.escape: Right after Nidalee uses Nidalee W Pounce is your chance to engage. Approach with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and land Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If you can transform using Void Coral, use the dash from Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet to close the gap too.
Nidalee.phase: Max Q first and look for duels from mid game onward, once you have completed your first core item and built up stacks. If you survive the early game, Bel'Veth becomes more favored as the game goes on thanks to her accumulated stacks.
Nidalee.teamfight: After your team absorbs the enemy engage, enter from the flank with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and target someone in the backline, including Nidalee. Watch where Nidalee steps out to throw a spear and whether she has used Nidalee W Pounce, then catch her with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If you take focused damage, survive with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom. If a kill drops Void Coral, collect it for the next fight.

MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong E Nimbus Strike is targeted, so stay outside its range to avoid it. Once he closes in, the armor reduction from Wukong Q Crushing Blow makes trading unfavorable. Do not use abilities on the stationary clone from Wukong W Warrior Trickster. If Wukong R Cyclone is ready, keep your distance and watch for its two knockups.
MonkeyKing.build: Build armor first against Wukong's main damage. Armor will not block the magic damage from Wukong E Nimbus Strike, though, and Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces armor, so avoiding his abilities matters too. If his healing makes him hard to finish with sustained damage, buy Executioner's Calling first and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
MonkeyKing.laning: Gank lanes where an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has a long escape route. If there is no clear gank opportunity, clear camps and establish vision around objectives.
MonkeyKing.combo: Once Wukong W Warrior Trickster and Wukong E Nimbus Strike are down, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and basic attack. Then knock him up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below and use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge again in the direction its hit reset. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when Wukong starts his burst combo, and do not use other abilities while channeling it.
MonkeyKing.escape: The window before Wukong W Warrior Trickster comes back up is your chance to engage. If Wukong E Nimbus Strike is also down, approach with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and stop his escape with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If Wukong R Cyclone has also just been fully spent, it is a good time to force a fight or contest an objective.
MonkeyKing.phase: Duels become viable from mid game onward, once you have maxed Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, completed your first core item, and built up stacks. Bel'Veth becomes favored in the late game with enough stacks, but avoid long duels where Wukong can build up armor and healing.
MonkeyKing.teamfight: If Wukong R Cyclone is ready, spread out from your allies. After your tank absorbs his engage, enter from the flank with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. Withstand focused damage with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom, then use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge to get out after killing someone. If a kill you helped secure drops Void Coral, collect it, transform with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet, and join the next fight.

MasterYi.watch: Master Yi cannot be targeted during Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, so strike just after he lands. Basic attacks with Master Yi E Wuju Style active deal some true damage. Slows do not work while Master Yi R Highlander is active, so do not rely on a slow alone to create distance.
MasterYi.build: If the healing from Master Yi W Meditate makes him hard to finish with sustained damage, buy Executioner's Calling first and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
MasterYi.fight: Right after Master Yi uses Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is your chance to close the gap. Knock him up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below when he lands, and use Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom to withstand his attacks the moment he unleashes them. If Master Yi R Highlander is active, use the knockup and Bel'Veth Q Void Surge to control your distance rather than relying on slows.
MasterYi.laning: Gank lanes where an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has a long escape route. If there is no clear gank opportunity, build stacks and establish vision around objectives.
MasterYi.combo: Once Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is down, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and basic attack, then hit Master Yi with Bel'Veth W Above and Below when he lands. Use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge again in the direction reset by W to keep up with him. When Master Yi starts using his abilities, activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom and do not use other abilities during its channel.
MasterYi.escape: Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is a mobility tool, so draw it out and engage with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge immediately afterward. Knocking him up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below after he lands leaves him less room to escape. If you have saved Bel'Veth W Above and Below when Master Yi activates Master Yi W Meditate, interrupt it with the knockup.
MasterYi.phase: Look for duels from mid game onward, once you have maxed Q, completed your first core item, and built up stacks. Master Yi also grows stronger as the game goes on, but Bel'Veth peaks in the late game with enough stacks, so take large monsters and secure kill participation in team fights.
MasterYi.teamfight: Absorb Master Yi's first engage with your team, then knock him up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below right after he lands from Master Yi Q Alpha Strike. Fight together so he cannot catch an ally alone and engage again. Enter from the flank with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, finish one target, and get out. If your kill participation drops Void Coral, collect it for the next fight.

Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! rolls in from a distance and knocks you up, so watch for its path from outside your river vision. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, its root comes later, so move away immediately. The longer you stay within Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero, the harder it becomes to escape.
Nunu.build: If healing from Nunu & Willump Q Consume makes them hard to finish with sustained attacks, buy Executioner's Calling first and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder. Bel'Veth can keep applying Grievous Wounds with basic attacks and Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. Build magic resistance against Nunu & Willump's main damage and tenacity against the snowball's crowd control.
Nunu.fight: Bel'Veth should avoid early skirmishes and fight after growing stronger. Dodge Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever!, escape the root from Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage, then close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. When Nunu & Willump start using their abilities, activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom to reduce incoming damage while attacking.
Nunu.laning: If there is no clear gank opportunity, clear large monsters to build Bel'Veth P Death in Lavender stacks.
Nunu.combo: Then knock them up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If it hits, use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge again in the reset direction to keep up. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when the enemy's ability damage comes in, and do not use other abilities during its channel.
Nunu.escape: When Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! approaches, move toward the incoming snowball and into the space Nunu & Willump have passed through instead of running straight away. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, disengage immediately with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. After dodging the snowball and root, look for a chance to reengage on Nunu & Willump, who have no way to create distance.
Nunu.phase: By mid game, duels become viable as you max Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, complete your first core item, and build stacks. In the late game, Bel'Veth is more favored with enough stacks, so keep growing through fight participation and kill participation on large monsters.
Nunu.teamfight: After your team absorbs Nunu & Willump’s engage, flank with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. When Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero begins, interrupt the channel with Bel'Veth W Above and Below; if you can’t interrupt it, leave the area. If coral drops after a takedown, check for it, transform with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet, and prepare for the next fight.

RekSai.watch: When Rek'Sai burrows, watch for the knockup from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow and move toward open ground, away from walls and narrow paths. Dodge as she emerges with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. If Rek'Sai has damaged you recently, stay close to allies in case she uses Rek'Sai R Void Rush.
RekSai.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker, Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel, and Rek'Sai R Void Rush. If her healing makes her hard to finish with sustained damage, buy Executioner's Calling first, then upgrade to Mortal Reminder.
RekSai.fight: Avoid early skirmishes, then keep dealing damage over time after dodging Rek'Sai’s engage. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when Rek'Sai commits her abilities to withstand the burst, and don’t use other abilities while channeling. If Rek'Sai Burrows to heal, don’t give her space; keep attacking.
RekSai.laning: Do not travel alone through areas without vision. Step on visible Rek'Sai tunnels to destroy them as you pass. Choose ganks where an ally has guaranteed crowd control or the enemy has a long way to retreat.
RekSai.combo: Close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and use basic attacks, then knock Rek'Sai up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If W hits, close in again with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge in the reset direction. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when Rek'Sai unloads her counterattack, and do not press Q or W during its cast.
RekSai.escape: The opening to engage comes after you dodge the knockup from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow. If only Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel is down, she can still escape with Rek'Sai R Void Rush. Wait until R is down too, then close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and cut off her escape path with Bel'Veth W Above and Below.
RekSai.phase: Bel'Veth can start taking duels in the mid game once she has maxed Q, completed her first core item, and built up stacks. She has the advantage in the late game with enough stacks, so get through the early game without falling behind and keep growing.
RekSai.teamfight: After your tank absorbs Rek'Sai's engage, enter from the side with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. If attacks focus on you, endure them with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom. After a kill, look for the dropped coral and transform with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet. Use the increased range and attack speed in the ensuing fight.

Poppy.build: Build armor first against Poppy's main damage. Poppy Q Hammer Shock scales with maximum health, so be cautious about stacking health alone. Do not spend resources on magic resistance just for Poppy.
Poppy.fight: Right after Poppy uses Poppy E Heroic Charge is an opening to close the gap. Confirm that Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended, then close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when Poppy starts unloading damage. Her armor increases as her health falls, so commit deeply only when you are sure you can finish her.
Poppy.laning: Avoid early skirmishes with Poppy. Take large jungle monsters to build Bel'Veth P Death in Lavender stacks. When facing Poppy, keep your back away from walls and leave the area left by Poppy Q Hammer Shock immediately. If you can step on the dropped shield from Poppy P Iron Ambassador first, deny her shield.
Poppy.combo: Once Poppy E Heroic Charge is down and Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and use basic attacks. Knock her up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below, then use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge again in the direction reset by the hit. While Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active, do not cancel it by pressing Bel'Veth Q Void Surge or Bel'Veth W Above and Below.
Poppy.phase: Look for duels from mid game, once Bel'Veth Q Void Surge is maxed, your first core item is complete, and you’ve built up stacks. Bel'Veth has the advantage in late game once you have enough stacks, so consistently secure takedown participation on large monsters and in team fights.
Poppy.escape: Engage right after Poppy uses Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended. Close the gap with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and cut off the enemy's escape direction with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If you can secure Void Coral and transform, you can also use Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet to close the gap.
Poppy.teamfight: If Poppy engages first, let an allied tank absorb it, then enter from the side. While Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, wait before engaging with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, and move out of the way if Poppy charges Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. After killing an enemy in the backline, use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge to escape, then secure the coral when it drops to prepare for the next fight.
Poppy.watch: While Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, don't dash in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge; wait for it to end or approach on foot. Stay in open space, since Poppy E Heroic Charge can stun you against a wall. If you're hit by the first strike of Poppy Q Hammer Shock, leave the zone to avoid the second hit. If Poppy starts charging Poppy R Keeper's Verdict, move sideways out of its path.

Rengar.watch: Rengar P Unseen Predator lets him leap from brush and build Ferocity, so avoid paths beside brush and establish vision when he is out of sight. When his Ferocity bar is full, Rengar E Bola Strike gains a root and Rengar W Battle Roar can remove crowd control; avoid trading then. When Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt is active, do not travel alone while injured.
Rengar.build: Build armor first against Rengar's main damage. If healing from Rengar W Battle Roar prevents Bel'Veth from finishing him with sustained damage, buy Executioner's Calling first, then upgrade to Mortal Reminder. Keep applying Grievous Wounds with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and basic attacks.
Rengar.fight: Bel'Veth should avoid early skirmishes and trade when Rengar's Ferocity bar is empty. Once Rengar W Battle Roar is down, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, then use Bel'Veth W Above and Below and deal damage. Use Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom to absorb the damage as Rengar starts unloading his abilities.
Rengar.laning: If Rengar is out of sight, avoid passing beside brush and use a Control Ward to gain vision inside it.
Rengar.combo: Avoid Rengar E Bola Strike. Once Rengar W Battle Roar is down, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and use basic attacks. Knock him up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below, then close in again with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge in the reset direction. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom as his burst damage lands, and do not use other abilities while it is active.
Rengar.escape: After avoiding Rengar E Bola Strike, engage with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge if his Ferocity bar is empty and Rengar W Battle Roar is also down. Rengar has no ability to create distance on his own, so land Bel'Veth W Above and Below to keep him close. When you need to retreat, move by switching the direction of Bel'Veth Q Void Surge.
Rengar.phase: Look for duels from mid game, once Bel'Veth has maxed Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, completed her first core item, and built up some Bel'Veth P Death in Lavender stacks. In the late game, with enough stacks, Bel'Veth has the advantage, so consistently secure large monsters and takedown participation in fights.
Rengar.teamfight: Wait for Rengar to engage with Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt while staying near your frontline and within vision. After an ally absorbs the engage, enter from the side with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. Once Rengar W Battle Roar is down, hold him with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. Endure focused attacks with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom. If kill participation causes coral to drop, secure it, transform with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet, and use the transformation in the ensuing fight.

Rammus.watch: When you see Rammus Q Powerball, put minions between you and him early. Give the followup Rammus R Soaring Slam a wide berth after he rolls in quickly. Rammus E Frenzying Taunt prevents you from moving or using abilities, so stay outside its range; as soon as it ends, create distance with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. Do not attack while Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active because of its high armor and reflected basic attack damage.
Rammus.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Rammus Q Powerball, Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl, and Rammus R Soaring Slam. If you need to kill Rammus directly, consider percentage penetration over flat penetration. Attack speed reduces the cooldown of Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, but faster basic attacks also increase the damage reflected by Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl.
Rammus.fight: Stop attacking when Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl activates, then focus your damage as soon as it ends. Once Rammus E Frenzying Taunt wears off, use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge to adjust your distance and keep fighting. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom as he unloads his abilities, and do not use other abilities during its cast.
Rammus.laning: Choose ganks when an ally has guaranteed crowd control or the enemy has pushed the lane and has a long way to retreat. Keep minions between you and an approaching Rammus Q Powerball, and establish vision around objectives instead of forcing an uncertain gank.
Rammus.combo: Once Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl ends and Rammus R Soaring Slam is down, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and use basic attacks. Knock him up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below, then use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge again in the direction reset by the hit. When Rammus starts unloading his abilities, endure them with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom, and do not press Q or W during its cast.
Rammus.escape: If Rammus E Frenzying Taunt is also down, close the gap with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and cut off his escape path with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet requires coral to transform, so confirm that condition before counting on it to engage.
Rammus.phase: Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and your first core item come online in the mid game, and you can take duels as your stacks build. Bel'Veth peaks in the late game with enough stacks, so keep securing takedown participation on large monsters and in fights.
Rammus.teamfight: Retreat well clear of a fast approaching Rammus Q Powerball and the area of the Rammus R Soaring Slam that follows. Move away from its landing spot too. After your tank absorbs the engage, enter the backline from the side with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and target one enemy. While Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, attack someone else. Endure focused damage with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom. After a kill, secure the dropped coral and prepare for the ensuing fight with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet.

Shaco.watch: Watch for fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box in bushes without vision and around objectives; check first with a Control Ward or Oracle Lens. If Shaco gets behind you with Shaco Q Deceive, his empowered basic attack is dangerous, so keep your back to a wall or face your allies when he is nearby. After health has decreased, avoid jungle paths and bushes without vision to avoid being hit by Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison.
Shaco.build: Early on, get Control Wards to check jungle entrances and objectives. Build magic resistance first against Shaco W Jack In The Box, Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison, and Shaco R Hallucinate. Get health as well to stay out of the health range where Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison deals more damage.
Shaco.fight: Right after Shaco Q Deceive is used, close the gap with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and cut off his escape with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. Use Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom to absorb damage as Shaco unloads his abilities.
Shaco.laning: Early on, maintain vision at your jungle entrances against Shaco's invades and ganks. Gank lanes where an ally has guaranteed crowd control or the enemy has a long way to retreat. If the gank angle is uncertain, clear large monsters to stack Bel'Veth P Death in Lavender and establish vision around objectives.
Shaco.combo: After Shaco Q Deceive is used, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, basic attack, and knock him up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If Bel'Veth W Above and Below hits the real Shaco, use the reset Bel'Veth Q Void Surge in that direction to close in again. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when Shaco's counterattack comes in, and do not press other abilities while channeling.
Shaco.escape: The moment after you force Shaco Q Deceive is your opening to engage. First check routes without vision where Shaco W Jack In The Box may be placed. Once you see Shaco Q Deceive has been used, engage with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and land Bel'Veth W Above and Below.
Shaco.phase: In the mid game, you can duel once you have Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, your first core item, and some stacks. In the late game, more Bel'Veth P Death in Lavender stacks favor you, so keep growing through takedown participation and large monsters.
Shaco.teamfight: If Shaco enters with Shaco Q Deceive and reveals himself, immediately focus the real Shaco with your team. After your allies absorb the engage, enter from the flank with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and withstand focused damage with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom. Do not waste damage on the clone from Shaco R Hallucinate; when it dies, move away from its location to avoid the explosion and fear.

Sejuani.watch: Sidestep Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and Sejuani R Glacial Prison. If the first hit of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath lands, move out of range before the second. Basic attacks from melee allies also build Sejuani E Permafrost stacks, so back away as the indicator fills.
Sejuani.build: Build magic resistance first to account for Sejuani's main damage. Sejuani W Winter's Wrath deals physical damage, while Sejuani P Fury of the North deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid simply stacking health. If the enemy has several immobilizing crowd control effects, fit a Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar between core items.
Sejuani.fight: After Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is used, close the gap with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom as Sejuani's burst combo lands, and do not press other abilities while channeling. Use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge to move out of range of the second hit of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath.
Sejuani.laning: Gank lanes where an ally has guaranteed crowd control or the enemy has a long way to retreat.
Sejuani.combo: Once Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is used, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, basic attack, and knock her up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If Bel'Veth W Above and Below hits, use the reset Bel'Veth Q Void Surge in that direction to engage again. When Sejuani starts unloading her abilities, activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom and do not use other abilities while channeling.
Sejuani.escape: The moment after you force Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is an opening to engage. Close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and land Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If Sejuani E Permafrost stacks are building or Sejuani R Glacial Prison is still available, create distance first to avoid the crowd control.
Sejuani.phase: You can duel from the mid game once you have maxed Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, completed your first core item, and built up stacks. Bel'Veth has the advantage in the late game when she has enough stacks, so consistently collect large monsters and takedown participation in teamfights.
Sejuani.teamfight: After your tank absorbs Sejuani's engage, enter the backline from the flank with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. Withstand focused targeted abilities with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom, then use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge to leave after a kill. If a takedown drops coral, collect it to transform with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet and look for the next fight.

Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact charges through terrain and stuns you on collision with a wall, so do not stand with your back to one. If Skarner R Impale suppresses you, Bel'Veth Q Void Surge cannot get you out, so take care when entering its short range.
Skarner.fight: After forcing Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, close the gap with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. Use Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom to withstand Skarner's abilities as he unloads them. Once you have withstood enough, end the channel and leave with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge.
Skarner.laning: Gank lanes where an ally has guaranteed crowd control or the enemy has a long way to retreat.
Skarner.combo: Once Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is used, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, basic attack, and knock him up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If Bel'Veth W Above and Below hits and resets the cooldown in that direction, reengage with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge.
Skarner.escape: Right after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is used is your chance to engage with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and land Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If Skarner R Impale is still available, engage knowing that Bel'Veth Q Void Surge cannot free you during its suppression.
Skarner.phase: Look for duels from the mid game after prioritizing Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and getting your first core item and stacks. Bel'Veth has the advantage in the late game once she has enough stacks.
Skarner.teamfight: After your allies absorb Skarner's engage, enter from the flank with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and target one enemy in the backline. Keep the short range of Skarner R Impale and the risk of being dragged at the edges of the Dragon and Baron pits in mind. If a kill occurs, collect the coral for the next fight.
Skarner.build: Decide in advance whether to fit Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar between your core items to counter the suppression from Skarner R Impale. If building resistance, prioritize magic resistance to mitigate damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and similar abilities.

Shyvana.watch: Shyvana is unstoppable while flying in with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, so use Bel'Veth W Above and Below after she lands. Absorb the overlapping damage from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis and Shyvana E Molten Burst with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom, then create distance with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge to prevent follow-up from Shyvana Q Emberstrike's empowered basic attacks.
Shyvana.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, Shyvana E Molten Burst, and Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, and get armor against her basic attacks. If her healing makes her hard to kill with sustained damage, buy Executioner's Calling first and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder. Shyvana Q Emberstrike and Shyvana E Molten Burst deal damage based on maximum health, so do not rely on stacking health alone.
Shyvana.fight: Engage when Shyvana's Fury bar is empty or Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is used. Close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and basic attack, but activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom to withstand her abilities as she unloads them. Press again when Shyvana returns from dragon form to human form and loses the bonus health and empowered abilities.
Shyvana.laning: Shyvana also has few Shyvana P Scalemail stacks early, so take her camps and objectives when a safe opportunity arises to slow her growth. Gank when an ally has guaranteed crowd control or the enemy has pushed the lane and has a long way to retreat.
Shyvana.combo: Once Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is used or she has landed, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, basic attack, and knock her up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If Bel'Veth W Above and Below hits, use the reset Bel'Veth Q Void Surge in that direction to close in again. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom as Shyvana's burst damage lands, and do not press Bel'Veth Q Void Surge or Bel'Veth W Above and Below while it is active.
Shyvana.escape: If Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is available, hold Bel'Veth W Above and Below and catch Shyvana after she enters with it and lands. If Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is used and her Fury bar is empty, you have an opening to engage and pressure her with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. When you need to leave, change direction to use the separate directional cooldowns of Bel'Veth Q Void Surge.
Shyvana.phase: Early on, avoid forced skirmishes while contesting Shyvana's camps and objectives to slow her growth. Bel'Veth can duel from the mid game once she has maxed Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, completed her first core item, and built up stacks, and she grows stronger in the late game. Shyvana also grows stronger as she gains permanent stacks.
Shyvana.teamfight: Spread out so the path of Shyvana R Dragon's Descent and the damage from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis and Shyvana E Molten Burst do not hit multiple allies. After your allies absorb Shyvana's engage, catch her on landing with Bel'Veth W Above and Below, then enter the backline from the flank with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. Withstand focused damage with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom. If a kill drops coral, collect it to prepare for the next fight with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet.

Taliyah.watch: Taliyah Q Threaded Volley cannot change direction during its cast, so dodge sideways. If the rock field is down, Taliyah W Seismic Shove can push you across it, so do not stand between Taliyah and the rock field.
Taliyah.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Taliyah Q Threaded Volley and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth. If the enemy team has multiple immobilizing crowd control effects that can lock down Bel'Veth, fit Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar between your core items.
Taliyah.fight: Avoid risky trades early. Dodge Taliyah Q Threaded Volley sideways and look for an opening to close in. When the rock field from Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is absent or you can go around it, approach with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and knock her up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below to continue attacking.
