When Taliyah starts unloading her abilities, activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom and do not press other abilities during its cast.
Taliyah.laning: Look for ganks when an ally has guaranteed crowd control or Taliyah has pushed the lane and has a long way to escape. If Taliyah disappears from the jungle, warn allies to back off in advance because she may move to another lane.
Taliyah.combo: Use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge to close in from an angle that avoids the rock field from Taliyah E Unraveled Earth, then use basic attacks. Land Bel'Veth W Above and Below to knock her up, then reengage with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge in the reset direction. When her burst combo starts, activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom, but do not press Q or W during its cast.
Taliyah.escape: Prioritize an opening before Taliyah R Weaver's Wall comes back, and check that Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is also down before engaging. If only one is down, she can escape with the other; close the gap with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge while avoiding the rock field, then land Bel'Veth W Above and Below.
Taliyah.phase: Max Bel'Veth Q Void Surge first and look for duels from mid game, once you have your first core item and stacks. Bel'Veth has a greater advantage late game with enough Bel'Veth P Death in Lavender stacks, so join team fights and secure takedown participation.
Taliyah.teamfight: After your tank absorbs the enemy engage, approach Taliyah in the backline from the flank with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. Go around Taliyah's rock field. If targeted abilities focus you, withstand them with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom, then retreat with Q. If Void Coral drops after a takedown, transform with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet and join the continuing fight.

Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede lets him close in quickly and stun you, so keep your distance just after he enters that stance. Immobilizing effects do not work during the awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede, so use Bel'Veth W Above and Below after the awakening ends. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on maximum health, so do not rely on building health alone.
Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr's main damage. Keep in mind that armor does not block the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm and that Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals mixed damage types. If healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle makes him hard to bring down with sustained damage, buy Executioner's Calling first and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Udyr.fight: Avoid early skirmishes and look for duels from mid game, once you have stacks and your first core item. When the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle is gone, follow him with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and give him no time to heal. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom as Udyr unloads his damage, and do not press other abilities while it lasts.
Udyr.laning: Use vision at key paths and jungle entrances to track Udyr, and do not push too far forward when he is out of sight. If a gank opportunity is uncertain, farm large monsters for Bel'Veth P Death in Lavender stacks and secure vision around objectives.
Udyr.combo: Bait out Udyr E Blazing Stampede, then close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and use basic attacks. Once the awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede ends, knock him up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below, then use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge again in the direction reset by the hit. When Udyr starts unloading his damage, absorb it with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom.
Udyr.escape: Just after baiting out Udyr E Blazing Stampede is your chance to close the gap with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. If you have taken one stun, use the period when he cannot stun the same target again to counterattack or escape. When escaping, change directions as you use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, then stop his pursuit with Bel'Veth W Above and Below after the awakened Udyr E Blazing Stampede ends.
Udyr.phase: Bel'Veth is weak early, so preserve your health and build Bel'Veth P Death in Lavender stacks instead of fighting Udyr. Duels become viable from mid game, once you have maxed Q, completed your first core item, and started building stacks. Bel'Veth has the advantage late game with enough stacks, so secure takedown participation in team fights.
Udyr.teamfight: Don't focus Udyr first when he has defensive items and the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle. After your allies absorb the engage, flank with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge to target a vulnerable enemy in the backline, and use Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom to endure concentrated damage. When Void Coral drops after a takedown, transform with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet and join the ensuing fight.

Viego.watch: The longer Viego charges Viego W Spectral Maw, the longer its stun lasts. Dodge sideways when you see him charging it, and interrupt it with Bel'Veth W Above and Below if it looks like it will hit you. If Viego E Harrowed Path appears on terrain, watch for his camouflage and avoid that path. Back away when your health is low, as you are an easy target for Viego R Heartbreaker.
Viego.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Viego Q Blade of The Ruined King and Viego R Heartbreaker. If a duel runs long and you need to cut his healing, buy Executioner's Calling and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Viego.fight: Viego can escape with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker, so do not rush in when only one is down. In particular, before Viego R Heartbreaker comes back, close the gap with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and stop his escape with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom to withstand his burst of attacks.
Viego.laning: Choose ganks where an ally has guaranteed crowd control or the enemy has a long way to escape down the lane. Avoid paths where Viego E Harrowed Path is visible.
Viego.combo: Close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, use a basic attack, then knock him up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If it hits, go in again with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge in the reset direction. When Viego starts unloading his abilities, activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom and do not press other abilities during its cast.
Viego.escape: The window to engage is after Viego W Spectral Maw is used and before Viego R Heartbreaker comes back. If Viego is charging Viego W Spectral Maw, dodge sideways or interrupt it with Bel'Veth W Above and Below before going in.
Viego.phase: Look for duels from mid game, once you have maxed Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, completed your first core item, and started building stacks. Bel'Veth has the advantage late game with enough stacks, so join team fights and secure takedown participation.
Viego.teamfight: After your tank absorbs Viego's engage, go in from the flank with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. Where an ally has fallen, keep your distance or block Viego's approach with Bel'Veth W Above and Below to prevent him from possessing them. If coral drops after a takedown, secure it and transform with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet to prepare for the continuing fight.

Zac.watch: When you see Zac charging Zac E Elastic Slingshot, interrupt him with Bel'Veth W Above and Below or dodge his landing spot with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. If the slow and knockup from Zac Q Stretching Strikes catch you, you are more likely to take the follow-up maximum health damage from Zac W Unstable Matter, so create distance after absorbing his engage.
Zac.build: If healing from Zac P Cell Division makes him hard to kill with sustained attacks, buy Executioner's Calling first and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder. Keep applying Grievous Wounds with Bel'Veth's basic attacks and Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, and build magic resistance rather than armor to withstand his damage.
Zac.fight: Close the gap just after baiting out Zac E Elastic Slingshot or interrupting its charge with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when Zac starts unloading his abilities, and step on the blobs he drops as you pass to prevent his healing.
Zac.combo: If Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and use basic attacks. Knock him up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below, then use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge again in the reset direction. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when Zac focuses his attacks on you, but do not press other abilities during its cast.
Zac.escape: Just after Zac E Elastic Slingshot is used is your chance to go in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and land Bel'Veth W Above and Below. When dodging Zac's engage or leaving a fight, change directions as you use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge.
Zac.phase: Look for duels from mid game, once you have Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and your first core item ready and have started building stacks. Bel'Veth has the advantage late game with enough stacks.
Zac.teamfight: After your frontline absorbs Zac's engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot, enter from the flank with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. Step on the blobs Zac drops to prevent his healing. If coral drops after you kill one target, transform with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet and continue into the next fight.

XinZhao.watch: Sidestep the thrust at the end of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning. If two empowered attacks from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike hit you, use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge to get out of range before the third knocks you up. While Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, keep your distance until its immunity ends instead of dealing damage from outside his spear range.
XinZhao.build: Xin Zhao deals primarily physical damage, so build armor first. If the healing from Xin Zhao P Determination makes him hard to beat with sustained damage, buy Executioner's Calling first, then upgrade to Mortal Reminder. Bel'Veth's basic attacks and hits with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge can keep applying Grievous Wounds.
XinZhao.fight: Avoid early skirmishes. Close the gap and fight right after Xin Zhao uses Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. When he starts using his abilities, reduce the damage with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom; do not press other abilities while channeling it. If Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, back away and counterattack when it ends.
XinZhao.laning: Choose ganks where an ally has guaranteed crowd control or the enemy has pushed up and has a long way to escape.
XinZhao.combo: After Xin Zhao uses Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, basic attack, then knock him up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If it hits, the cooldown of Bel'Veth Q Void Surge resets in that direction, letting you dash in again. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when Xin Zhao starts his burst combo, and do not press Q or W while channeling it.
XinZhao.escape: Right after forcing out Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is your opening to engage with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. Dodge the third hit of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, then land Bel'Veth W Above and Below to cut off his escape route. If you have transformed with Void Coral, you can also use the dash from Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet to close the gap.
XinZhao.phase: Duels become viable from mid game onward, once you have maxed Bel'Veth Q Void Surge first, completed your first core item, and begun stacking. Bel'Veth grows stronger late game with enough stacks, so secure takedown participation from large monsters and teamfights.
XinZhao.teamfight: Let your tank absorb Xin Zhao's engage, and keep some space between yourself and your allies so the knockback from Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard does not split your formation. When its immunity ends, use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge to enter the backline from the flank, kill one target, then dash out with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. If attacks focus on you right after you enter, survive with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom. Collect any coral that drops after the kill to prepare for the next fight.

Vi.watch: Vi Q Vault Breaker deals more damage when charged, so back away or sidestep when you see her charging it. You cannot stop Vi R Cease and Desist while she is rushing toward you; use Bel'Veth W Above and Below after she lands and the knockup ends. Vi W Denting Blows becomes more dangerous as she repeatedly hits the same target, so avoid a prolonged fight.
Vi.build: Build armor first against Vi's main damage. Vi W Denting Blows reduces armor and deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid building only a large health pool. If the enemy team has several crowd control effects that can lock down Bel'Veth, consider Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar between core items.
Vi.fight: Immediately after dodging or forcing out Vi Q Vault Breaker, close the gap with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. If Vi P Blast Shield is active, start trading damage after it is removed, and avoid a long exchange that lets Vi W Denting Blows stack. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when Vi's attacks come in, then use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge to create distance after enduring as much as needed.
Vi.laning: Choose ganks where an ally has guaranteed crowd control or the enemy has a long way to escape. Right after Vi uses Vi Q Vault Breaker is a chance to close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge.
Vi.combo: After Vi uses Vi Q Vault Breaker, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, basic attack, and knock her up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If it hits, the cooldown of Bel'Veth Q Void Surge resets in that direction, so use it again immediately in the same direction. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when Vi's attacks come in, and do not press Q or W while channeling it.
Vi.escape: Right after Vi uses Vi Q Vault Breaker is your opening to engage with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. Save Bel'Veth W Above and Below while Vi R Cease and Desist is rushing toward you; use it after she lands and the knockup ends. When you need to retreat, use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge in different directions.
Vi.phase: Look for duels from mid game onward, once you have maxed Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, completed your first core item, and built up stacks. Bel'Veth has the advantage late game with enough stacks, so keep taking large monsters and securing takedown participation in fights.
Vi.teamfight: After your tank absorbs Vi's engage, enter from the flank with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. Do not use Bel'Veth W Above and Below while Vi R Cease and Desist is rushing in; knock her up after she lands to stop her engage. If you are focused, survive with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom. If coral drops after a kill, use Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet to transform and prepare for the next fight.

Warwick.watch: While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, he takes greatly reduced damage and will trigger a fear. Back away, then reengage after the fear goes off. Warwick R Infinite Duress suppresses Bel'Veth and prevents all actions, so watch for his leap. When your health falls below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals your position and makes him faster, so do not linger.
Warwick.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast, and Warwick R Infinite Duress. Armor also has value against his basic attacks' physical damage. If his healing makes him hard to finish with sustained damage, buy Executioner's Calling and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder.
Warwick.fight: Do not unload your damage while Warwick E Primal Howl is active; fight after the fear goes off. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom to reduce damage when Warwick unleashes his attacks, and do not press other abilities while channeling it.
Warwick.laning: Early on, kill large monsters to build stacks of Bel'Veth P Death in Lavender instead of forcing ganks. Choose ganks where an ally has guaranteed crowd control or the enemy has a long way to escape. If your health drops below half and Warwick W Blood Hunt could let him chase you, give up some farm and recall.
Warwick.combo: After Warwick uses his mobility ability, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, basic attack, and knock him up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If Bel'Veth W Above and Below hits, use the reset Bel'Veth Q Void Surge in that direction to engage again. Activate Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom when Warwick counterattacks, and do not press Q or W while channeling it.
Warwick.escape: Do not engage just because Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down. Your opening comes after Warwick R Infinite Duress is also down and the fear from Warwick E Primal Howl has gone off. Then close the gap with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and use Bel'Veth W Above and Below to cut off his escape route.
Warwick.phase: Duels become viable from mid game onward, once you have maxed Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, completed your first core item, and begun stacking. Bel'Veth has the advantage late game with enough stacks, so keep taking large monsters and securing takedown participation in teamfights.
Warwick.teamfight: After your tank absorbs Warwick's engage, enter from the flank with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, finish one target, then dash out with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. If Warwick R Infinite Duress catches an ally, prioritize saving that ally and counterattack while Warwick is held in place during the suppression. If takedown participation causes Void Coral to drop, collect it, transform with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet, and prepare for the next fight.

Nocturne.watch: If Nocturne Q Duskbringer hits you, Nocturne can approach quickly along the trail it leaves. Turn toward an ally or turret instead of fleeing in a straight line. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror tethers you, use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge to create distance and break it before the fear triggers. When Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, remove the shield first so it does not block Bel'Veth W Above and Below.
Nocturne.build: Nocturne deals primarily physical damage, so build armor first. If the healing from Nocturne P Umbra Blades makes him hard to defeat with sustained damage, buy Executioner's Calling first, then upgrade to Mortal Reminder.
Nocturne.fight: Close the gap with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, but save a dash direction to break Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror. When Nocturne starts unleashing his attacks, absorb them with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom.
Nocturne.laning: Early on, focus on killing large jungle monsters and securing vision around objectives instead of skirmishing with Nocturne. Choose ganks where an ally has guaranteed crowd control or the enemy has a long way to escape. Maintain vision along the river and at jungle entrances to prepare for Nocturne's engage.
Nocturne.combo: If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is down, close in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, basic attack, knock him up with Bel'Veth W Above and Below, then use the reset Bel'Veth Q Void Surge in that direction to engage again. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, remove the shield with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge first, then land Bel'Veth W Above and Below to reset Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. Pressing Q or W while Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active cancels it, so absorb the attacks before continuing.
Nocturne.escape: Once Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is down, there is less need to save a Bel'Veth Q Void Surge dash to break the fear. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is still available, remove the shield before using Bel'Veth W Above and Below.
Nocturne.phase: Look for duels from mid game onward, once you have maxed Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, completed your first core item, and begun stacking. Bel'Veth has the advantage late game with enough Bel'Veth P Death in Lavender stacks, so secure takedown participation from large monsters and teamfights.
Nocturne.teamfight: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens the screen, move toward your allies immediately so you are not targeted alone. After an ally absorbs Nocturne's engage, enter from the flank with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and survive focused attacks with Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom. If takedown participation causes coral to drop, collect it, transform with Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet, and prepare for the next fight.
